subject: MPA: security gates & close timeline — SOC 2, SIG, DPA checkpoints
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Tom Li <tom.li@finxcorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MPA: security gates & close timeline — SOC 2, SIG, DPA checkpoints

Tom — thanks again for taking time yesterday. Per our demo, attaching an initial mutual action plan focused on the security/compliance lane so we can align on what "close" looks from FinXCorp's perspective. High level asks in this thread: 

- Confirm which artifacts you need prior to commercial close (SOC 2 type, SIG/CAIQ responses, DPA redline + key data retention terms).
- Clarify whether FinXCorp requires proofs in a staging environment or an in-production acceptance window.
- Preferred timeline for legal procurement (target close we discussed: end of October).

Attachments: FinXCorp_MPA_v0.3.pdf (draft MAP with milestone dates)

Summary of relevant security gates in the draft: 
1) SOC 2 attestation (Redwood will provide SOC 2 Type II report and point-in-time evidence). Acceptance: review by your security team + signoff within 7 business days of delivery.
2) SIG/CAIQ: our completed questionnaire (PDF) + a short Q&A session. Acceptance: topical clarifications resolved, outstanding items logged in the MAP.
3) DPA: we propose Redwood standard DPA; please flag material redlines — legal owners listed in the MAP.
4) Data retention & residency: default retention 90 days for request logs, 180 days for billing metadata; EU residency available as an option (addendum).

Kimberly / Priyom — looping you to own the SOC2 evidence package and the DPA redline response respectively. I put rough target dates in the attached PDF; flexible to shift based on FinX needs.

Next step: Tom, can you confirm who on your side will own security sign-off and procurement cadence? If helpful we can set a 30-min triage next week.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Li <tom.li@finxcorp.com>

Cc: security@finxcorp.com, procure@finxcorp.com, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA: security gates & close timeline — SOC 2, SIG, DPA checkpoints

Lauren — appreciate the clear draft. Quick answers from our side to help tighten the MAP: 

- Security owner: forwarding to our InfoSec lead (security@finxcorp.com) — they will review the SOC2 report and the CAIQ. They prefer to receive the SOC2 package and an evidence index (not full evidence blobs) first.
- Procurement owner: procure@finxcorp.com — procurement will require a redline of the proposed DPA and a summary of SLAs around data access and breach notification.
- On staging vs production: at first pass security wants evidence in our sandbox environment for a short test run (20k sample requests) to validate telemetry and masking behavior; second pass can be live acceptance post-contract. That said, procurement may insist a mutually-agreed acceptance window post-launch. 

Timeline constraints: we have a board procurement freeze week of Sep 28–Oct 2; if we want an October close we need to accelerate the legal thread this week. Can we get the SOC2 evidence index + completed CAIQ by EOD Tue (14 Sep)? Also, procurement asks for a simple one-page summary of data retention and deletion workflows for legal review.

I can join a 30-min triage on Mon or Tue afternoon PT — propose Tue 14 Sep 2:00pm PT.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Li
Director, Strategic Partnerships — FinXCorp
+1 212-555-0110

Tom / FinXCorp team — thanks for the quick turn. Per your asks, attached are: 
- FinXCorp_MPA_v0.3.pdf (updated: moved SOC2 evidence delivery to 2026-09-17; added sandbox test window 2026-09-20 — 2026-09-22)
- SOC2-evidence-checklist.xlsx (evidence index and point owners; note: these are references to artifacts our SOC2 auditor aggregates)

Key clarifications inline: 
- SOC2 package: we will deliver the auditor's SOC2 Type II report on 2026-09-17 along with an evidence index; per best practice we do not send raw PII-containing logs — we provide redacted traces and auditor attestations.
- SIG/CAIQ: Kimberly will upload our completed CAIQ and be available for a 30-min Q&A; any follow-ups will be tracked as action items in the MAP.
- DPA redlines: Priyom (legal) will review and provide a marked-up DPA by 2026-09-20; key negotiation points called out: data deletion SLA, subprocessor list notice period, and EU residency addendum.
- Data retention summary (one-pager): included in page 2 of the attached MAP and in the Drive link; retention defaults are configurable per account.

Next steps I propose:
1) Tue 14 Sep 14:00 PT — 30-min triage (Tom confirmed; inviting FinXCorp security + procurement).
2) SOC2 package delivery 17 Sep.
3) Sandbox demonstration window 20–22 Sep.
4) DPA target redline 20 Sep; legal loop to close in the week of Sep 27 (to avoid the freeze week).

If that timeline works, we'll mark milestones as "on-track" in the MAP and share an updated Gantt in Drive.
